questions.0.explain.t: Without it, anyone who discovers the real address ignores all edge protection.

questions.0.options.0.t: Otherwise the attacker talks directly to the origin and bypasses WAF, bots and limits

questions.0.options.3.t: Because the origin does not support HTTPS

questions.0.q.t: Why lock down the origin to accept traffic only from the edge?

questions.1.explain.t: Payments tend to close; public pages tend to open. The decision should be conscious and tested.

questions.1.options.0.t: If the control fails, traffic is blocked: safe, but unavailable

questions.1.options.1.t: If the control fails, traffic passes

questions.2.explain.t: Each layer covers the blind spot of the previous one: the edge handles what does not depend on the business.

questions.2.options.0.t: The edge does not know the business context, such as who can see that order

questions.2.options.1.t: The edge does not read headers

questions.2.options.3.t: Because the edge does not support HTTPS

questions.2.q.t: Why can per-object authorization not live only at the edge?
